name: Fieldset
purpose: Render a finished native group for related controls with a legend, group messaging, and inherited Atom state.
useWhen: Multiple related controls answer one group question.

avoidWhen.condition: Only one control needs a label.

composition: Compose Fieldset.Root -> Fieldset.Legend -> optional description/error -> Fields or grouped choices.

rules.statement: Give the related group a meaningful legend.
Load styles.css or core.css plus fieldset.css and child component styles.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using visual heading and div wrappers for a related choice group.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Fieldset so the group label and state remain semantic.

validation: Check group messaging, state propagation, spacing, and responsive layout.
